title: Compare classification and probability metrics
description: You evaluate two logistic models and inspect ROC and reliability plots.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You convert linear scores to probabilities with sigmoid and apply the supplied threshold for labels. The confusion counts provide precision and recall.
You vary score thresholds to build false-positive and true-positive rates. Trapezoidal integration gives AUC, while the Brier score averages squared probability errors.

steps.question: Do the recorded models have the same printed AUC when their printed accuracies match?
steps.answer: Both accuracies are 0.900, but GD prints AUC 0.949 and Newton prints 0.948. Both Brier scores print as 0.0829.

steps.description: You draw both receiver operating characteristic curves with a diagonal reference. Their axes show false-positive rate and true-positive rate.
You group predicted probabilities into bins and plot each populated bin's observed positive frequency. Empty bins receive NaN in the reliability plot.
